notes.title: NEON BEATS ON APPLE DEVICES [iPhone, iPad, Mac, AppleTV]
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

After a long period without communication, we are here to give you some news about Neon Beats. We have been working for several months on the creation of a version of Neon Beats available on Apple devices.

[h2]We are proud to announce the release of Neon Beats on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV today![/h2]

This paid version contains the levels of the main game + the levels of the DLC "A Beat Further", as well as all their mechanics and music that have been integrated into the more recent levels. 
You can find it here: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1527569581?pt=2026737&ct=steam&mt=8

If you want to compare your scores and interact with other players, we remind you that we have a Discord server right here: https://discordapp.com/invite/q2S486A

We would like to thank you once again for your patience and support, and hope that you will once again have a great time on Neon Beats!

OKYO Games

notes.title: NEW DLC AVAILABLE - A BEAT FURTHER
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Here we are! The DLC is finally live. You can purchase it on Steam via this link:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1256030/Neon_Beats__A_beat_further/

In this DLC you can find 5 new levels with their own music, new mechanics, more collectibles and all that with the same minimalist visuals!

If you want to compare your score with other players, you can join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/q2S486A]Discord![/url]

We would like to thank all of you for your patience and support! Don’t hesitate to tell us what you thought about the new levels and what was your favorite one!

OKYO Games

notes.title: Work in progress
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Just a quick message to inform you that since September, we started working again on Neon Beats in order to create more content! You can expect new levels new mechanics and obviously new musics. We will tell you more information when we are ready.


Thank you all very much for your patience and support!

notes.title: Future of Neon Beats
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We promised you great [b]news[/b], here they are!

As some of you know, we are a group of [b]students [/b]in Game Design. We created Neon Beats for a School Project, and at the beginning it should have stayed like that, but passion made us continue working on it and even releasing it without any expectations, to then carry on with our study. 

But seeing all the comments and reviews, we decided to talk about [b]Neon Beats[/b] future…

[h1]We are super excited to announce you that we will continue the project for the next school year to come! With new levels, new mechanics, and much more![/h1]

We will be able to [b]fully concentrate[/b] on Neon Beats from [b]September[/b], but during the whole summer we’ll still be active on social media and Discord to communicate any information with you. 

Furthermore, thanks to the [b]community [/b]we are now officially on [b]speedrun.com[/b], go and show us what you’ve got! 
Link: https://www.speedrun.com/Neon_Beats

We are grateful for your support and patience :D 

OKYO Games

notes.title: Patchnote #01
notes.notes:
Good morning, everyone! 

We're [b]updating [/b]the game today! 

On the patchnote:

- Adding of centiseconds to the level timers
- You can now restart the level from the beginning by simply pressing the R button on your keyboard or the Y button on your Xbox controller
- A tolerance was added to walljumps in the case you push the button too early, which make it smoother. 

See you really [b]soon [/b]for more information about the game! 


OKYO Games

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone ! 

First, we really wanted to [b]thank you[/b] all to play the game! You are a lot to gives us good reviews on Steam, we are truly touched! We did not expect so much feedbacks so quickly. 

Thanks to you, [b]Neon Beats[/b] was propelled into the main Steam page in the section new and popular, it’s amazing! 

We noticed that you were a lot to compare your stats and scores about the different levels and shared your speedruns on Youtube and TwitchTV! We have decided to create a [url=https://discord.gg/q2S486A]Discord[/url] dedicated to the game to regroup all players on a single one platform, so here is the link to join it: https://discord.gg/q2S486A

We are currently working a lot on the future of the game and what we are going to do in the next months, so do not hesitate to follow us on our different social media:
